description: This file defines logging support for the project, including log levels, a Logger struct for logging messages at different severity levels, and an extension to initialize LogLevel from a configuration string.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Provides logging functionality with different severity levels, filtering based on the current log level.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a given log level if it meets the current threshold.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a message at the trace level.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs a message at the debug level.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Logs a message at the info level.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Logs a message at the warning level.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Logs a message at the error level.
